Case_14009/figure2.jpg.source_caption: CT of the neck with contrast, coronal view.

description.short_caption: Coronal CT of the neck with contrast showing soft tissue swelling.
description.detailed_description: This is a coronal CT image of the neck with contrast. The image shows soft tissue swelling and asymmetry on the right side of the neck, with possible involvement of the deep cervical spaces. The contrast highlights vascular structures and enhances soft tissue differentiation. The trachea appears slightly deviated to the left, suggesting a mass effect or significant inflammation.
visible_findings: soft tissue swelling on the right side of the neck
contrast enhancement of vascular and soft tissue structures

Case_14009/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Subcutaneous to intra-abdominal abscess, HE stain.

description.short_caption: Histopathology of subcutaneous to intra-abdominal abscess, H&E stain.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a high-power view of tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E). The field contains numerous inflammatory cells, including neutrophils and lymphocytes, indicative of an abscess. There are also areas of necrosis and cellular debris, consistent with tissue destruction. The presence of these features suggests an infectious or inflammatory process.
visible_findings: inflammatory infiltrate with neutrophils and lymphocytes

Case_14009/figure4.jpg.source_caption: Right thigh mass, HE stain, high power.

description.short_caption: Histopathology of right thigh mass, HE stain, high power view.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a high-power view of tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin (HE). The field is densely populated with small, round to oval cells exhibiting hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, consistent with a monomorphic population. Occasional mitotic figures are visible, suggesting high cellular turnover. There is minimal stromal component, and the architecture appears disrupted, indicative of a neoplastic process.
visible_findings: dense population of small, round to oval cells

Case_14009/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Left neck mass, HE stain, high power.

description.short_caption: Histopathology of left neck mass, H&E stain, high power.
description.detailed_description: This high-power histopathology image shows a dense infiltrate of small, darkly staining lymphoid cells. Scattered among them are large, oval, eosinophilic structures consistent with yeast forms, some of which exhibit a characteristic broad-based budding morphology. The background is composed of a mix of inflammatory cells and necrotic debris. The tissue is stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), highlighting the fungal elements and cellular architecture.
